name: Steward Ansgar
title: Of the Household
examine: Soft-spoken, chalk-dusted, and carrying the whole castle in a ledger under one arm. The quiet is professional.
lines: Four hundred meals a week out of five hearths, and the Crown notices exactly the one that runs late.
Amberford grain, Greenstair greens, Saltmere salt when the road is kind. A castle is a list, properly kept.
The Queen checks my sums. I have started leaving one small error in, so she has something to find.
